info.title: build_calculator_estimate
info.description: STARTS a background run of the REAL Azure Pricing Calculator (via the ca-calc container) for one engagement. Reads the engagement's published estimate (latest.json + tools_raw.json) and _engagement.json, translates the target-state design + right-sized workloads into a calculator line-item spec (Landfall supplies quantities, the calculator supplies every price), then kicks the ca-calc container which drives the live calculator and writes landing_zone.xlsx / landing_zone.json / landing_zone.png to the engagement folder itself. The run takes a few minutes, so this returns 202 immediately — poll get_calculator_estimate for status, or tell the user to watch the dashboard 'Azure landing zone — Pricing Calculator POE' card. Call publish_estimate first.

post.summary: Start the Azure Pricing Calculator POE build for an engagement (async)
post.description: Pass the engagement id (<customer>/<project>). Returns 202 with status 'building' — the calculator run happens in the background and takes a few minutes. Tell the user the POE is being built and to watch the dashboard 'Azure landing zone — Pricing Calculator POE' card, or call get_calculator_estimate with the same engagement to check whether it is ready. Do NOT expect the monthly total in this response.

include_dr_compute.description: Add warm standby DR compute in the DR region (default false — DR runs on failover only; an ASR line is always included when a DR region is set).

202.description: The calculator run has been started
